description: Create a life goal the user explicitly wants to track. Not a calendar event or streak tracker. Numeric goals are totals that build up and need target_value and target_unit; rate goals are a number per calendar month that can go down, such as monthly revenue, and need the same two fields; habit goals need habit_frequency and habit_target_count. Ask for missing facts; never invent aspirations. ($0.10; API key required)

checkin_frequency.description: How often to check in on the goal: daily, weekly or monthly, e.g. weekly.

current_value.description: Progress so far in target_unit, e.g. 5.

description.description: What the goal is, e.g. Run a half marathon by March.

habit_frequency.description: How often the habit repeats, e.g. weekly.

habit_target_count.description: Times per period needed to hit the habit target, e.g. 3.

motivation.description: Why the goal matters to the user, e.g. To stay healthy for my kids.

obstacles.description: What might get in the way, e.g. Long work travel.

priority.description: Priority level: high, medium or low, e.g. medium.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

target_type.description: Goal type: completion, numeric, rate or habit, e.g. numeric.

target_value.description: Number the goal aims for, e.g. 21.

title.description: Goal title, e.g. Run a half marathon.
